headline: Anthropic is asking users of Claude's voice features to let it use their voice recordings to train its AI models.
score_reason: Pool score kept: optional and off by default, so limited impact.
importance_line: Claude voice users decide whether their recordings are used for training, a choice separate from chat training; BleepingComputer saw it off by default, but the report rests on its own view of the interface.
summary: BleepingComputer reports that Anthropic has begun showing Claude voice users a prompt asking them to allow their audio recordings and voice chats to be used to improve its AI models. The choice is optional, sits in a separate privacy setting from chat training, and was switched off by default in the interface the outlet saw, with users able to turn it off and delete the data later.
